how_to_apply: Scroll down and click on the relevant advertisement, then download and carefully read Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17.
Register online under "Recruitment of Junior Associates 2026", providing your details in one sitting or saving and resuming (available up to three times before final submission).
Upload your scanned photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per the specified guidelines, and capture a live photograph via webcam or mobile phone.
Pay the requisite application fee online through debit card, credit card, or Internet Banking (fee is Nil for SC/ST/PwBD/XS/DXS, and ₹750 for General/OBC/EWS candidates).
Review your application carefully before final submission - no corrections or edits are allowed after final submission.
Submit the application before the last date, 31.08.2026, and take a printout of the system-generated application form for your own record (this printout is not to be sent to SBI).

For any problem in filling up the form, payment of fee, or receipt of admission/call letter, candidates may contact the helpdesk at 022-22820427 (between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM on Bank working days) or lodge a query at http://cgrs.ibps.in, mentioning 'Recruitment of Junior Associate-2026' in the subject line.

content_sections.heading: SBI Junior Associate Vacancy 2026: State-wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 7,680 regular vacancies and 1,444 backlog vacancies are notified across 24 Circles/States/UTs. Candidates can apply for only one State/UT and must be proficient in that State/UT's specified local language. The Bank has clarified that these vacancies are provisional and may vary depending on actual requirement. The "Regular Vacancies" column shows figures in the order SC/ST/OBC/EWS/GEN/Total. Backlog vacancies for PwBD and Ex-Servicemen/Disabled Ex-Servicemen (XS/DXS) categories are shown separately from the backlog SC/ST/OBC figures, as given in the notification; the source does not provide one single combined backlog total per state, so these are kept as separate columns rather than summed. Backlog vacancies are net of the vacancies advertised in the Special Recruitment Drive (Advt. No. CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16) for SC/ST/OBC candidates. Candidates applying for Maharashtra (Maharashtra Circle/Mumbai Metro Circle) or Uttar Pradesh (Lucknow Circle) should check the operational areas for which they wish to apply, using the Branch Locator on SBI's official website, https://sbi.co.in.

content_sections.heading: SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized University, or any equivalent qualification recognized as such by the Central Government. Candidates with an Integrated Dual Degree (IDD) certificate must ensure the date of passing the IDD is on or before 31.12.2026. Candidates in their final year/semester of graduation may also apply provisionally, subject to producing proof of having passed the graduation examination on or before 31.12.2026. Matriculate Ex-servicemen who have obtained the Indian Army Special Certificate of Education, or the corresponding certificate in the Navy or Air Force, after completing not less than 15 years of service in the Armed Forces of the Union, are also eligible. Such certificates should be dated on or before 31.12.2026. Not below 20 years and not above 28 years - i.e., candidates must have been born not earlier than 02.04.1998 and not later than 01.04.2006 (both days inclusive). Cumulative age relaxation is not available either under the above items or in combination with any other item. Candidates seeking age relaxation must submit copies of the necessary certificates at the time of joining; no change in category is permitted after registration of the online application, and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained. Candidates who are working in SBI in the Clerical cadre are not eligible to apply under this project, and candidates who were earlier employed in State Bank of India and resigned while in the clerical cadre are also not eligible. Candidates against whom there is an adverse report regarding character, antecedents, or moral turpitude are also not eligible to apply for the post. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Reservation
content_sections.text: 4% horizontal reservation is provided to Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), as per Section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, for categories including Blind/Low Vision, Deaf/Hard of Hearing, locomotor disabilities (one/both arms, one/both legs, cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims, muscular dystrophy, spinal deformity/injury), Autism Spectrum Disorder (mild), intellectual disability, specific learning disability, mental illness, and multiple disabilities. 4.5% of total vacancies are reserved for Disabled Ex-Servicemen and dependents of servicemen killed in action, in addition to the 10% earmarked for Ex-Servicemen (a total of 14.50%). First priority in appointment goes to Disabled Ex-Servicemen, and second priority to dependents of defence personnel killed in action or severely disabled (over 50% disability attributable to defence services). Reservation for PwBD/XS/DXS candidates is horizontal and is included within the vacancies of the various parent categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/GEN) to which the candidate belongs. OBC vacancies are available only to candidates in the "Non-Creamy Layer"; OBC candidates in the "Creamy Layer" are not entitled to any OBC relaxation/reservation and must indicate their category as General. Benefit of reservation under the EWS category requires an Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2025-26, valid for 2026-27, issued by a Competent Authority on the Government of India format.

content_sections.heading: SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: The pay scale for Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) is Rs. 24,050-1340/3-28,070-1650/3-33,020-2000/4-41,020-2340/7-57,400-4400/1-61,800-2680/1-64,480. The starting Basic Pay is Rs. 26,730 (Rs. 24,050 plus two advance increments admissible to graduates). The total starting emoluments of a Clerical Cadre employee posted at a Metro like Mumbai will be around Rs. 46,000 per month, inclusive of Dearness Allowance, other allowances at the current rate, and two additional increments for newly recruited graduate Junior Associates. Allowances may vary depending on the place of posting. Selected candidates will be eligible for reimbursement of various perquisites, provident fund, pension under the New Pension Scheme (Defined Contribution Benefit), medical, leave-fare, and other facilities as per Bank instructions issued from time to time.

content_sections.heading: SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Terms of Employment
content_sections.text: Candidature will be considered only against the vacancies in the State/UT for which the candidate has applied. A candidate may appear for the online examination from any notified centre, but will have to appear for the specified opted local language test at a centre decided by the Bank in the State applied for, at their own expense. The merit list will be drawn up State-wise and category-wise, and candidates will be posted in the State for which they applied, if selected. Pre-Examination Training will be arranged by the Bank for SC/ST/OBC/Ex-servicemen/PwBD category candidates who opt for it in the online application, conducted online, in line with Government of India guidelines.

rows.details: Minimum 6 months; newly recruited Junior Associates must complete prescribed e-lessons during probation to be confirmed, and the probation period may be extended if performance does not meet the Bank's expectations

No provision for transfer before completion of 5 years of service; after 5 years, transfer may be considered only in exceptional cases such as Extreme Compassionate Ground/Spouse Ground, at the Bank's sole discretion

Customer calls, banking services, advisory services, and cross-selling of products, inside and outside Bank premises, with possible extensive outdoor travelling, flexible working hours, and shift work
